primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-push-pull (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 3174-3195

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: coherence is read with the Noetherian characterization and its Serre subcategory property; if f has a section the intersection injects into the pullback of G along the section, hence is coherent; in general finite-type descent along f reduces coherence to f^*(F cap f_*G), which by flatness equals f^*F cap f^*f_*G, and flat base change rewrites f^*f_*G as p_*q^*G with p having a section, reducing to the section case (source lines 3197-3217)
